rebrew.schema.json is the dispatch contract shared with ai.relumea.app.backend-go,
which mirrors it byte-identically at contracts/dispatch/rebrew.schema.json
(generated there with `go run ./cmd/surface-tracker`). The metadata operations
(rebrew.metadata_describe, rebrew.metadata_diff, rebrew.metadata_carry, the
version 3 capture descriptor and the apply_candidate metadata field) were
extended here first; the rest is the copy of backend commit
80314a46a1ae26d9ef3d56d90e1d454c561f5928.
SHA-256: 0720f1a9b98614e7d3850530cffd74d5d4afc0a3f53a401df758bddb70d7585a.
tests/test_ops.py validates every op request and reply against it.
